English.ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_below_:
The arrow on the left directly below the toolbar collapses or restores the tools: up to collapse, down to expand. In portrait, the tool strip runs horizontally below the toolbar; swipe it to reach more tools. In landscape, it stays on the left. Brush groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to expand its tools and settings directly below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap it again to collapse; the arrow reverses. Categories remember the tool last used in them. Scroll the bounded options panel for further settings and edit controls. Both panels start expanded on the first launch of this layout; later choices are remembered. In landscape, the top controls share one row with the filename centred. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The FG/BG colour indicator stays fixed at the lower left, beside the palette. The palette opens directly to its right on the same row. Its arrow is on the right edge: left to collapse the palette, right to expand it. Collapsing hides the extra swatches without moving the indicator. Tapping the colour box also toggles the palette. Tap a swatch for foreground or hold for background. FG/BG opens Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. The four cells at the far right keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Hold a custom swatch to replace it. The main editor uses opaque colours; transparent imports are placed onto the current BG colour. Original source files are unchanged.

Navigate replaces the magnifying-glass tool: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Tap Navigate again or Draw again to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas in the view. View also provides 100% and a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the sidebar. Commit selection applies the result as one undoable selection edit; autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is in the second row of edit icons, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut/Copy and Paste/Select all form two rows below How to use. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Brush category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then pan to draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnified preview displays the cursor or drawing point at an adjustable magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya and Openclipart. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Unplace removes just the selected placement and closes the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

「Rewke itokpa」: owpeka itokpa nuye wa, tu suy moymoye wa rewe yan. 「Poronno sikkew an katuhu」: sikkew kik wa, kes sikkew tu suy kik hene 「Poronno sikkew an katuhu okere」 eywanke hene ki yan. 「Poronno sikkew an katuhu esina」 aykapte wa, naa a=esina ka somo ki ukokote itokpa nuye easkay. 「Sikkew sikari katuhu」: a=moymoye itokpa ani 「Tumu wano pes pakno (px)」 anu yan. Sinep sinep kor na takne pes kor emko pakno patek a=anu easkay. 「Itak」: kampiso kik wa, kor nuye katu ani a=nukare itokpa-noka numke wa, nani a=nukare noka nukar yan. Pororu, 「Poro itokpa」, 「Itokpa sam un kiru」, 「Itak pok itokpa」, 「Itak kasi itokpa」, 「Itak uneno katu」, 「Itak a=nuye uske utur (%)」 newa BG iro ani itak a=nuye uske a=ecarse iyanu an. 「Wakka ani iro nuye」 anak 「Hunte」 or ta 「Hunte」 newa 「Rera ani iro nuye」 kor sam ta an. 「Iro a=omare pakno (%)」 sinnare wa na riten itokpa nuye yan. Nikamkorinuyep, hunte newa mosma aeywankep kor pororu a=sinnare itokpa anak 100 pixel pakno ne. Nikamkorinuyep anak 1 pixel wano hoski, kor pararu a=eramuan. A=nukare cipiskip kik wa sonno cipiskip nuye yan. 「Sampe」, 「Nociw」 newa 「Ay」 ka mosma katuhu neno pes nuye hene onnay ecarse hene numke easkay. 「Nukar → Nuye uske itokpa nuye」 ani askayre/aykapte iyanu, nuye uske itokpa kor katuhu newa a=porore wa a=nukar iyanu a=sarare. Moymoye wa nuye uske itokpa anu yan. Sos or ta an 「Nuye」 kik wa, sos moymoye wa nuye yan. Suy kik wa nuye hontomotuye yan. Hunte newa nuye katu kor iyanu anak 「Nuye → Nuye」 or ta an. 「Nukar → Porore cietokonukarpe」 ani nuye uske itokpa hene a=nuye uske hene a=porore wa a=nukare. Porore pakno sinnare easkay. 「Nuye iyanu」 or ta pixel kor pes a=ratcire iyanu newa tek ani a=nuye itokpa a=ratcire iyanu ka an. Na 11 itokpa-noka a=omare wa an. 「Itokpa-noka kor uesere」 or ta kar kur kor rehe newa irenka opitta an.

「Cinuyep → Noka maka」 ani Android kor cinuyep a=numke aeywankep eywanke wa kampiso a=itasare. 「Nuye → Omare → Mosma noka」 or ta kikay kor cinuyep, Catrobat, Irasutoya newa Openclipart kor noka omare easkay. Kikay kor noka numke hene, Internet or ta an noka kor sos maka wa 「Noka eywanke」 kik hene ki yan. Noka numkep ne a=omare; naa a=okere ka somo ki. 「Cinuyep → Yayopeyope, uesere newa kar kur → Noka-kar-kur newa uesere」 or ta etok kor URL newa uesere kor itak a=ama. Kikay kor a=eywanke easkay RAM or ta easkay noka anak hoski pixel cipiskip ani a=nure. Kon rusuy yakun, pororu a=sinnare iyanu or ta pararu, riru, pixel cipiskip newa RAM kor cipiskip a=nukare. Nea RAM kor cipiskip pakno RAM a=eywanke kuni a=ramu. Pixel hene % hene ani pororu numke wa 「Katuhu somo sinnare no」 ka numke easkay. Etok kor cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki.

「Cinuyep → Noka ukote」 ani noka 20 pakno a=ukote mosma uske a=maka. Pon noka cinuyep rehe hene a=sinnare hi hene ani upekare yan. Sine noka tuye hene poronno noka tuye hene ki easkay. 「Uneno pararu」 newa 「Uneno riru」 ani a=nure noka opitta kor pororu uneno a=kar; noka sinep sinep kor katuhu a=sinnare ka somo ki. Pon noka hene a=anu noka hene moymoye wa, simoysam un kote wa sapa uneno anu, corpok un kote wa harkisam pes uneno anu easkay. 「A=anu noka hosipire」 ani a=numke noka patek a=anu uske wano a=hosipire. Ios an noka anak nea isam uske un a=anu. 「Opitta nukare」 anak a=nukar pororu patek a=sinnare. 「PNG ama」 ani noka ukote a=sanke. 「Paint or ta nuye」 ani noka a=nuye uske un a=eikra; 「Husko katukar」 ani tan sinna hosipire easkay. Tan aeywankep anak pok an pe a=nukar eaykap sine noka a=nuye kusu ne. Noka ukote anak noka a=anu mosma uske ne.

「Cinuyep → Yayopeyope, uesere newa kar kur」 or ta hoski tan aeywankep kor kur kor itak, noka newa itokpa-noka kar kur kor rehe, uesere kor itak opitta, newa tan aeywankep a=kar kusu itak opitta an. Uesere kor itak a=moymoye wa a=nukar kor, 「Opitta attupte」, 「Mosma irenka」 newa 「Okere」 anak a=moymoye ka somo ki no ramma an.
